sentences: I wake up at seven o'clock.
I go to work by bus.
I start work at nine and finish at five.
أبدأ العمل في التاسعة وأنتهي في الخامسة.
What time is it? — It's half past three.
What time do you go to bed?
We have dinner together at eight.
Do you cook? — Yes, I do.

grammar.intro_en: Use it for habits and routines. at + time (at 7) · on + day (on Monday) · in the morning / afternoon / evening · at night

write_speak:
Write & Speak — “My day”: write 8 sentences about your normal day, with times. Say it aloud without looking.
Example: I wake up at six thirty. I take a shower and have breakfast. I leave home at half past seven. I start work at eight. I have lunch at two. I come back home at five. In the evening I relax and watch TV. I go to bed at eleven.
